label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: No visible cue to jump past the long header menu and carousel: it took about 24 Tab presses to reach the first Add to cart button, passing menu items that each appear twice (a summary and a link) and slideshow controls
One link in the header was announced with no name at all, so I could not tell where it led
Pressing Add to cart gave no immediate feedback on screen; only on a re-read did I learn the cart drawer had opened with an added message

Reaching Checkout in the cart drawer took 13 Tab presses through the progress bar, quantity buttons, remove button and upsell items; a Remove button sat right before the quantity controls, easy to hit by mistake
After pressing Checkout the page showed nothing and nothing was focused until I re-read it, so a screen user gets no sign that the page loaded
